_comment: Example input for Bestiary → Import…. Hand this file to whatever is writing
your stat blocks as a shape to follow. Everything except `name` is optional.
The importer is forgiving: a bare array works, a single creature object works,
stat keys match by id, label or abbreviation (case- and space-insensitive), and
stats may sit at the top level instead of under `stats`. It is strict about one
thing only — a stat the active ruleset does not declare is dropped, and the
preview tells you which before anything is written.
Stat ids below are Traveller's (see src/systems/traveller/system.json).
Dragonbane's are hp, armor and movement.

creatures.name: Grey Wolf

abilities.name: Pack hunter
abilities.description: +1 DM to attack when flanking with another wolf.

creatures.description: Lean and grey-brown, 40kg, hunts in packs of six to twelve.
